column3: “To come its time” is rendered “so that her time will come,” and “on itself” as “contrary to her interest.”
“Unclean of name” is rendered “of ill repute.”
“Interest and interest” is rendered “interest and profits.”
“You will be profaned by yourself” is rendered “you will profane yourself”; the LXX reads “I will be profaned.”
“Conspiracy of prophets” follows the Hebrew; the LXX reads “princes.” “Persons” is rendered “lives.”
